scalars.scalar_value: 2 shifts per week and as needed

items.item_text: Basic Life Support - CPR - Authorized by the American Heart Association

Prepares and performs twelve-lead EKGs with self identification and thorough instructions to patient, producing results of test according to department standards. Ensures proper placement of electrodes, with documentation of all pertinent patient information, paying special attention to accuracy of name, age, DOB and interpreting physician 95% to 98% of the time.

Prepares and performs treadmill and holter monitor testing with self identification and thorough instruction to patient. Ensures proper placement of electrodes with special emphasis to skin preparation to ensure quality test results. Assists physician during stress testing to provide patient safety and demonstrates the ability to respond effectively in the event of an emergent situation 95% to 98% of the time

Transcribes patient information to applicable forms maintaining accuracy, thoroughness and legibility. Copies, files and distributes records to appropriate areas with completion of clerical duties by the end of shift, with no more than 5 to 8 omissions per month. Edit and confirm tests in the Muse System with 95% accuracy

Demonstrates knowledge and skills necessary in the use of HOSPITAL INFORMATION SYSTEM (HIS). Duties include charge posting, crediting, acknowledging results to patients bill and ability to access patient information with an error rate of no more than 3-5 months.

Maintains proper care of equipment, including cleaning and restocking daily. Initiates request for equipment repair with Biomed department with notification to supervisor. Notifies proper person of any supply deficits within the department and disperses delivered supplies upon arrival to appropriate location with no more than 1 to 2 outages of unit of unit supplies per month.
Assists supervisor with department CQI program by participation in the collection and documentation of current statistics.

Demonstrated knowledge of EKG procedures and equipment, basic cardiac and human body anatomy and physiology, basic interpretation of cardiac arrhythmias, cardiopulmonary resuscitation, aseptic techniques.
